author: Sohn, Ho-min; Bender, Byron W.
title: A Ulithian grammar
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (Internet Archive scan in Downloads, no text layer; chapter III read from page images and OCR). A revised version of the first author's University of Hawaii dissertation of 1969 (Preface). Data from Mogmog speakers, with Falalop and Fais forms (pp. 5-6). A generative analysis: the phonemes are those of base forms, from which ordered rules derive the surface forms (§3.6). The Ulithian sketch of Lynch et al. (2002: 792-803) is abstracted from this grammar.
